verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents scheduled tasks that run on a recurring cron schedule, with examples such as every 5 minutes or 9.30am every other Monday. A community user independently confirms the scheduled task feature works as expected. This is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off trigger. Missing for 10: evidence of dynamic or programmatic schedule management (creating or editing schedules via API, MCP or agent tools) and timezone configuration details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: A task that is triggered on a recurring schedule using cron syntax.
Use schedules for recurring tasks, like a cron job every 5 minutes, a task that runs at 9.30am every other Monday
The scheduled task feature has been a lifesaver—super simple and just works exactly as expected.
